about: Held-out retrieval eval set for search_knowledge (/search). Each candidate mirrors a bench-heldout.js coding task that has (or lacks) a KB scar note. Queries are agent-style search_knowledge phrasing mined from .graph/gate-journal.jsonl during held-out bench runs — not the prose spec text. Relevance is keyed on note TITLE (match: title), same as eval-set.json. Positive candidates expect their winner note in top-k; interval-merge is a negative control (no scar exists — pass when no positive winner title contaminates top-k).
